message:
Hello Alina,

My grandmother left me her engagement ring. It is a small diamond on a thin yellow gold band, and it has sat in a drawer for years because it doesn't really feel like me. I would love to turn it into something I could wear every day, maybe a pendant? I live in Seattle and could come over on the ferry.

Rosalind
